name: Felarch

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Combat Master
bonuses.text: When using a weapon in each hand, the DN penalty for Multi-Attack is reduced by 2.

bonuses.name: Intense Emotions
bonuses.text: This Threat takes a penalty of +1 DN to all Resolve Tests.

bonuses.name: Reavers of the Void
bonuses.text: This Threat's attacks gain +2 bonus dice during All-Out Attacks.

bonuses.name: Uncanny Balance
bonuses.text: Corsairs gain +1 bonus die when they use Athletics (S) Interaction Attacks.

abilities.name: Reaver of the Void
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Felarch Seizes the Initiative and gains +3 bonus dice to all attack Tests.

abilities.name: Outcast Coordinator
abilities.text: When a Felarch rolls a Wrath Critical, an ally that shares its [COTERIE] Keyword within 6m may immediately Move or take an Action.

determination: Enduring Resolve: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 3d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Include a Wrath Die in this Threat's Determination rolls. If the Wrath die rolls an Icon, the Threat does not suffer Shock damage for this Determination roll, the Wounds are simply ignored.
note: Core prints the Corsair Felarch only as a sidebar option of the Corsair (a variant on corsair), not a block, so this takes a plain id. The Plasma Grenade line is printed in bold.
